findings.finding: The Series C holder's resale registration for 4,512,400 conversion shares, about 1.9x the 2.37M shares outstanding, has been effective since 2026-09-24. Today's close resets the conversion price to about $1.00 (80% of a roughly $1.25 low close, at the $1.00 floor), so on 2026-09-29 the holder can convert at $1.00 and sell into any price above it.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The registration is already effective and the conversion formula reads the 5 prior closes, today's among them. Tomorrow's conversions are the first that can price off today's close. The 4.99% beneficial-ownership blocker forces convert-sell-repeat cycles rather than one block, so the supply arrives across sessions and not all at once today.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The previous resale S-1 for the same holder went effective 2026-05-13. Next-close moves in the baseline: 05-14 -33.56% (drop day) then -23.47%, 05-15 -36.67%, 05-18 -8.42%. That is three further down sessions while that registration was being worked. Across all 9 comparable falls: median next close -8.21%, 3 of 9 up.
findings.why_not_priced: The close holds what the holder sold today, into a PR spike, at a conversion price near $1.33 (80% of the pre-drop low close). It does not hold the reset: from tomorrow the holder's cost is $1.00 and 451,240 preferred ($4.51m stated) remain. If the price held this, it would already sit near the $1.00 floor, where the holder's incentive ends. Spot is $1.25, about 25% above it.
findings.independence: The 10-Q gives the formula, the $1.00 floor and 440,343 preferred converted by 06-30 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2079272/000121390026089380/ea0299462-10q_lakewood.htm). The DRS of 2026-08-24 is the same resale, drafted for 5,000,000 shares (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2079272/000121390026092773/filename1.htm). The price shape points the same way: +23% gap and -39% intraday on 215x volume is a seller meeting retail demand. All the documents come from one issuer, so the independence is thin.

findings.finding: The 8-K Item 5.07 reporting the 2026-09-22 annual meeting vote is due by 2026-09-28 (four business days) and was not on EDGAR at the screen instant. It reports reverse split authority of up to 1:20 cumulative and an authorized-share increase from 12.5M to 100M.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The Item 5.07 four-business-day clock (09-23, 09-24, 09-25, 09-28) runs out today, so a compliant filing lands after this close and is visible before or during the 09-29 session.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-06-17 8-K (items 3.03/5.03, the 1:10 reverse split) coincided with the -17.81% fall on 06-17 and a -35.0% next close. That was an implemented split, a larger event than an authorization.
findings.why_not_priced: The proposals have been public since the proxy. What is new is the confirmed 100M authorized shares, which removes any headroom limit on converting the Series C, and a live 1:20 authority. Small, because most of it was knowable. It would be priced if the stock had not reacted to the proxy, which cannot be tested here.
findings.independence: The PRE 14A of 2026-07-30 carries the same proposals (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2079272/000121390026083353/ea0299275-pre14a_lakewood.htm). It is the same issuer and is not independent.
